My method for getting people to blog in 2017 is the same as it was in 1999. Roll out the red carpet for great examples of blogging. Then the Tom Sawyer [thing](http://scripting.com/stories/2011/01/08/youCanGetAnythingYouWant.html#) kicks in. :cherries:
